premises: Trace Y addition improves oxide-scale adhesion in alumina-forming alloys via the reactive element effect (REE).
Y segregates to oxide grain boundaries, reducing cation outward diffusion and growth stress.
Y forms discrete interfacial oxide particles (e.g., Y2O3) that mechanically pin the scale and inhibit spallation.
The REE has been demonstrated in conventional Ni- and Fe-based superalloys.
The specific FeNiCuAl-based HEA with Y addition (Innovation Alloy) shows drastically reduced oxidation rate and enhanced scale adhesion with Y2O3 particles.
